title: testslot dhondt
summary: A security council must allocate exactly 10 indivisible test slots among components A, B, and C with priority weights 100, 60, and 30. Policy specifies a highest-averages divisor allocation: repeatedly give the next slot to the component with largest weight divided by one plus its current slot count, breaking exact ties A before B before C. The team must compute the final allocation and contrast it with naive quota rounding.
